reason: The candidate action attempts to remove items from the pending order by passing an empty new_item_ids array. However, the policy defines 'Modify items' for pending orders as: 'each item can be modified to an available new item of the same product but of different product option.' This describes swapping items to different variants of the same product, not removing items entirely. The policy does not provide authorization for removing specific items from a pending order (other than canceling the entire order). The empty new_item_ids array violates the policy's requirement that modified items be changed TO an available new item.
policy_references: Modify items section: 'For a pending order, each item can be modified to an available new item of the same product but of different product option.'
Modify pending order: 'you can take actions to modify its shipping address, payment method, or product item options, but nothing else.'
